PROPERTIES.player_hint_1_en: Only one square of row 3 is still open to anyone (row 3, column 3). Someone must stand there, so nobody else can use column 3. Bella's own clue ("She was exactly two columns east of Angus.") rules out more squares. All of Dora's squares are in column 4, so nobody else can use it. So Bella (B) must be at row 3, column 3. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_2_en: Cedric's clue ("There was another man in his area.") needs a partner who does not share his row or column; that rules out squares for Cedric. All of Angus's squares are in column 1, so nobody else can use it. So Cedric (C) must be at row 2, column 2. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_3_en: With the rows and columns of Bella and Cedric crossed out, only one square is left for Angus that fits his clue ("He was in the Gym."). So Angus (A) must be at row 1, column 1. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_4_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Vernon. So Vernon (the victim) must be at row 5, column 5. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_5_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Dora that fits her clue ("She was not sitting in a chair. She was in the Library."). So Dora (D) must be at row 4, column 4. Cross out her row and column. Dora is the only person in the Library with Vernon, so Dora is the murderer!

CHARACTERS.char_quote_en_1: She was exactly two columns east of Angus.
CHARACTERS.char_quote_en_2: There was another man in his area.
CHARACTERS.char_quote_en_3: She was not sitting in a chair. She was in the Library.
CHARACTERS.char_quote_en_4: The Victim. He was alone with the murderer.
